---
name: bug
description: Use when the user wants to report or document a bug before deciding whether it should be fixed.
user-invocable: true
disable-model-invocation: true
---

The user wants to report a bug.

Follow these steps, ask one question at a time:

1. Ask what the user is doing.
2. Ask what happened.
3. Ask what was expected.

Create a markdown file under the `Bugs` folder that clearly describes the bug.

Then ask the user if the bug should be fixed.
